hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 identified through ROM

inputs.name: RAM-only ESP32-S31 U-Boot SPL ROM image
OpenSBI and U-Boot firmware FIT
inputs.revision: U-Boot 2026.10; OpenSBI 1.9; S31 firmware FIT configuration

scenario: Start the RAM-only SPL using the vendor ROM and transfer the firmware FIT through its UART receiver; observe the next stages on the UART console. The trial does not install firmware to nonvolatile storage.
expected: The complete FIT transfers, the SPL verifies image hashes, OpenSBI starts and U-Boot reaches its interactive prompt.
observed: The SPL reported receiving 322032 bytes and verified the FIT image hashes. OpenSBI reported ESP32-S31 firmware active. U-Boot 2026.10 reported DRAM 299.9 KiB (total 16.3 MiB) and reached the esp32s31 prompt.
limits: This is a RAM-only bootloader result on one operator-reported V1.2 sample and silicon revision 0.0; other units and revisions were not tested.
The output does not establish EmberBSD kernel boot, a persistent installation, a successful restoration or operation across power cycles.
The trial did not perform a full-range PSRAM read/write test; U-Boot DRAM reporting includes the available memory regions and is not a separate PSRAM capacity measurement.
FIT image hashes check integrity but do not establish authenticated firmware.
The UART trace and device identifiers remain private; no raw logs or identifiers are published.
